subject: Urgent: candidate held at customs — availability & coverage options
messages:
From: Ana Gomez <ana@talentbridge.co>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jun 2028 08:15:00 -0400
Subject: Candidate delayed at customs — need coverage options

Hi team,

Quick heads-up: Carlos Ruiz (final loop with Acme Analytics) is currently being held at customs in EWR for additional document checks. Border officer estimates the hold may be 4–8 hours given the paperwork backlog. He’s on the 07:10 flight from MEX and is at the airport; main issue looks administrative, not medical.

Two asks:
- Can we shift today's panel (scheduled 2:00 PM ET) to later today if he clears, or would you prefer we move to tomorrow morning?
- If you want to keep momentum, Carlos is open to doing a shortened technical screen over video once cleared and the remainder tomorrow.

I can share passport scan and transit receipt (attached) once I get permission from Carlos — he’s OK with sharing.

Apologies for the noise. I wanted to surface options so you can decide quickly.

Thanks,
Ana
Ana Gomez | Senior Recruiter, TalentBridge
Mobile: +1 917-555-0127
[Attachment: transit_receipt.pdf]
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 17 Jun 2028 08:27:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Candidate delayed at customs — need coverage options

Thanks Ana — and sorry to hear that.

Short answers:
- If clearing is uncertain > 3 hours, let's reschedule to tomorrow morning 9:00 AM ET.
- If he clears within 3 hours and feels OK, we can run a 30–40 minute remote technical screen today with one interviewer and finish the loop tomorrow.

Mina/Jonas: can someone cover a condensed technical screen today (single interviewer, 40 mins) around 4:00 PM ET if Carlos clears? If not, we'll move everything to 9:00 AM tomorrow and I'll send a new invite.

Ana: please attach whatever documents he’s comfortable sharing (passport scan, itinerary). Also ask if Carlos prefers a single interviewer to reduce fatigue.

I’ll hold the calendar tentatively until we confirm.

-Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma

Thanks — I’ll keep my afternoon flexible.

Update: good news — Carlos cleared customs at 09:45. He is still at the airport, passport checks took longer than expected. He’s willing to do a shortened technical screen today at 4:00 PM ET but asks that the session be capped at 35 minutes because he’s been up since 2:00 AM local and will be traveling to a hotel.

I’ve attached the passport scan and his latest resume (PDF). He confirmed he prefers a single interviewer today (not the full panel). If you choose today, we’ll run: 35m technical (Mina) + follow-up full panel tomorrow at 9:00 AM ET.

Attachments: passport_scan.jpg, candidate_resume_Carlos_Ruiz.pdf

Carlos (copied) — are you okay with a virtual 4:00 PM ET quick screen and then the full loop tomorrow 9:00 AM ET?

Best,
Ana

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 18 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Final plan — move full loop to tomorrow 9:00 AM ET; optional 35m screen today

Thanks everyone for the quick responses and flexibility. Given Carlos's travel fatigue, let’s play it safe:

- Cancel the full panel for today.
- Optional: Mina, if you’re still OK, please run the 35-minute technical screen today at 4:00 PM ET (calendar invite sent). If Mina’s unavailable, we’ll skip today.
- Full loop rescheduled for tomorrow, 9:00 AM ET — I’ve updated the Acme panel calendar and sent invites to the candidate and internal interviewers.
- Action item: Stephanie — please upload Carlos's cleared passport and the transit receipt to the Acme ATS record and add a short note about the customs delay for audit.

Mina: confirm whether you’ll take the optional 4:00 PM slot and I’ll finalize.

-Nikhil
